description: The source lists dwelling-unit counts by year and municipality or municipal district. It defines a dwelling as one or more rooms intended for accommodation, potentially including cooking, eating, living, sleeping and sanitary facilities. Package coverage is 1994–2021. CSV, spreadsheet, JSON and XML exports and an exploration interface are listed. These counts describe building accommodation stock; occupancy, floor area, structural condition and available utility connections are not established. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
